description: Use when you need news articles or headlines from the last 72 hours about a topic, company or person. Do not use for full article text, paywalled sources, non-English coverage or news older than 72 hours. Returns JSON with recent news articles matching keywords: headline, URL, source, publish time, authors, tone, image and the people and organizations named, from GDELT for 0.008 USDC per call. Typical response time 600 ms (p95). Category: Search. Price: US$0.008 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).

domain.description: Only articles from this source domain, e.g. reuters.com

hours.description: How far back to look, in hours (1-72, 24 when omitted)

limit.description: Maximum articles to return (1-50, 20 when omitted)

query.description: Keywords to find in headlines, people and organizations, e.g. nvidia earnings (all words must match)

name: blackwood_news_search
title: News headlines search
